milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the melon block and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. The melon is placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 5] inside a 3-sided fenced farm area (open on the west side). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance (the sandbox agent could clearly see the melon from ~8 blocks away at step 10), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the melon rather than away from it. position_near_with_facing is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target' rather than just proximity.
